# newreleases_release (Data Source)

Reads a single release of a tracked project. Omit `version` to read the latest non-excluded release — useful for pinning a version elsewhere in the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Latest non-excluded release of a tracked project.
data "newreleases_release" "go_latest" {
  provider_name = "github"
  name          = "golang/go"
}

# A specific release, including its release note.
data "newreleases_release" "go1_21" {
  id      = newreleases_project.go.id
  version = "go1.21.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the tracked project. Conflicts with `provider_name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the tracked project. Requires `provider_name`.
- `provider_name` (String) Upstream provider of the tracked project. Requires `name`.
- `version` (String) Release version. When omitted, the latest non-excluded release is read and this attribute is set to its version.

### Read-Only

- `cve` (List of String) CVE identifiers referenced by the release.
- `date` (String) Release date in RFC 3339 format.
- `has_note` (Boolean) Whether the release has a release note.
- `is_excluded` (Boolean) Whether the release is excluded by the project's filters.
- `is_prerelease` (Boolean) Whether the release is a pre-release.
- `is_updated` (Boolean) Whether the release was updated after publication.
- `note_message` (String) Release note body (HTML); null when the release has no note.
- `note_title` (String) Release note title; null when the release has no note.
- `note_url` (String) Release note URL; null when the release has no note.
